credits.title: Rodin
credits.overview: Auguste Rodin (1840-1917), man of the people, autodidact and revolutionary sculptor - the most brilliant of his era. At 42, Rodin meets Camille Claudel, a young woman desperate to become his assistant. He quickly acknowledges her as his most able pupil, and treats her as an equal in matters of creation.

credits.title: Holy Lola
credits.overview: The story of a young couple, Pierre and Geraldine, and their desire for a child, which leads them on a journey of initiation to Cambodia.  On their difficult and transformative adventure, they must contend with obstructive authorities and the jealousies and mistrust of a small community of would-be adoptive parents.

credits.title: When the Sea Rises
credits.overview: An actress, who goes all over rural France with her monologe "Sex and Crime", meets and falls in love with a man, since that moment starts helping him in his plays.

credits.title: A Piece of Sky
credits.overview: A woman struggles to acclimate to prison life while her friend organises a labour strike on the outside.

credits.title: Humanité
credits.overview: In a quiet little French town, two detectives are tasked with investigating the brutal rape and murder of a preteen girl.
